incidents.title: KnowBe4 hires North Korean IT worker using AI-enhanced photo
incidents.outcome: Laptop started loading malware on arrival and was isolated in about 25 minutes; KnowBe4 says no data was accessed.
incidents.confidenceReason: KnowBe4's CEO post says the application photo was AI-enhanced from stock imagery (per search summary of the page; the exact sentence was not located in the fetched text).
incidents.summary: KnowBe4 hired a remote engineer using a stolen valid US identity and an AI-altered photo after four video interviews. Company, Mandiant and FBI attributed it to a North Korean operation.
incidents.quote: How a North Korean Fake IT Worker Tried to Infiltrate Us

incidents.title: Sophisticated AI-generated GitBook lures phishing the crypto industry
incidents.outcome: Thousands of lure pages across crypto brands.
incidents.confidenceReason: Netcraft attributes the text to LLMs from the pages it tracked.

incidents.quote: Many lures use LLM-generated text to enable the threat actor to create unique content for thousands of pages that span a wide range of target brands.
incidents.singleSourceReason: Only Netcraft has reported this operation among the sources found in the 2026-11-17 sweep.
